tasks.short: Read changes in import and export regulations

steps.what: Open changes in import and export regulations
Do the reading of current literature
Attend meetings by conferring with colleagues

tasks.design: A list of regulation changes is opened from {GOV_PORTAL} into {DOCS}. The broker does the reading. Meetings and conferences stay on {CALENDAR}, and the note stores the regulation id, not a score of a colleague.
tasks.previous_blocker: Changes arrived as unread mail, so a new rule was easy to miss until a filing failed.
tasks.enabler_now: The feed can list what changed, which lets the broker spend the time on reading rather than hunting.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a new rule, and what it means for a client, stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker decides which change matters for the book of work.
tasks.altitude: The broker sees the week's regulation changes before the reading.

reach.learn: Which regulation the note refers to.

evidence.claim: A change list can be opened, and the reading and the meetings stay with the broker. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when the regulation feed has a new item and ends when the broker has noted which changes matter.
A change row has regulation id, title, and date, produced by the authority's feed. A title with no id is read by the broker without being filed as a rule.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the feed covers every rule this book of work actually uses.
research_questions: Which changes were listed and not yet read?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is collecting titles that the feed already lists. Reading, conferences, and the judgement stay with the broker.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the shipment value and the tariff
Calculate duty and tariff payments on shipments
Check the payments figure against the tariff
Release the payments figure the broker accepted

tasks.design: Value comes from {ERP} and the rate from the published tariff in {GOV_PORTAL}. The payments figure is the stored rate times the stored value. The broker checks it before it is released. A missing rate is not guessed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The figure was worked in a side sheet from a rate someone had copied earlier.
tasks.enabler_now: The rate and the value are stored against the shipment, so the multiplication does not need a side sheet.
tasks.still_hard: A rate that is not in the table, or a value that is not agreed, still needs the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker accepts the figure before anyone relies on it.

ambition.what: A shipment with a stored value and rate gets its figure the same day, and the broker still accepts it.

tasks.altitude: The broker sees the rate and the value beside the figure.

reach.task: Use the figure in the payment
reach.learn: Which tariff line the figure used.

evidence.claim: A duty payment is a stored rate times a stored value, checked by the broker. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a shipment has a value and a tariff line and ends when the broker has accepted the payments figure.
The line has shipment id, customs value, and tariff code, produced by the entry. A missing rate stops the figure.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the customs value is agreed before the rate is applied.
research_questions: Which shipments stopped because the rate was not in the table?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: payments figure the broker accepted for that shipment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts shipments whose value and rate are both stored. A free-text value falls back to the broker, and the check before release stays.

tasks.short: Confer with officials on customs clearance

steps.what: Open the goods held for customs clearance
Confer with officials at the agencies
Note quarantine points that are still open

tasks.design: Holds are opened from {GOV_PORTAL}. The broker confers with officials by {TELEPHONY} or in person. Quarantine points are written in {DOCS} by the broker. The system does not speak for the broker.
tasks.previous_blocker: The hold was a phone call with no list, so the same question was asked twice.
tasks.enabler_now: The hold list shows which goods are waiting, so the call starts from a named entry.
tasks.still_hard: An official's answer, and whether it actually facilitates clearance, stays a conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The broker decides which point is still open after the call.
tasks.altitude: The broker sees the holds before the call with the agencies.

reach.learn: Which entry the question was about.

evidence.claim: The list of holds can be opened, and the conference with officials stays in person. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when goods are held by an agency and ends when the broker has noted which points remain.
A hold has entry id, agency, and reason, produced by the authority. A hold with no entry id is handled from the call notes.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether every agency writes the hold into the same status feed.
research_questions: Which quarantine points are still open after the conference?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a hold that is already on the entry. The conference and the judgement stay with the broker.

tasks.short: Obtain line releases for frequent shippers

steps.what: Open frequent shippers and their commodities
Obtain line releases for those frequent shippers
Note container loads the release did not cover

tasks.design: A frequent shipper's commodities and volume are opened from {ERP}. The broker obtains the line release from the authority through {GOV_PORTAL}. Loads that the release does not cover stay listed. The system does not grant the release.
tasks.previous_blocker: The request was a letter rebuilt for every shipper, with the volume retyped.
tasks.enabler_now: The shipper record already holds commodities and entry volume, so the request starts from that record.
tasks.still_hard: The authority decides whether to grant the release, and a mixed load still needs the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker sends the request and judges which loads it does not cover.
tasks.altitude: The broker sees the shipper's commodities before asking for a release.

reach.learn: Which shipper and which loads were asked.

evidence.claim: The shipper record can be opened, and obtaining the release stays with the broker and the authority. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a frequent shipper needs a line release and ends when the broker has sent the request.
The record has shipper id, commodity ids, and entry counts, produced by the shipment file. A shipper with no commodity id is requested by the broker from the papers.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the authority accepts a request that starts from the shipper record.
research_questions: Which loads are still outside the release that was requested?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: release request the broker is sending for that shipper

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is not retyping a shipper record that already exists. The request, and the authority's decision, stay with people.

role.altitude: Reading the law stays with the broker. Duty math uses a stored rate. Talks with officials stay in person. A line release is requested by the broker, not granted by the system.
reach: A colleague sees which regulation changed.
An official sees which shipper was requested.
skills_to_grow: Do not treat a listed title as a rule that has been read.
